struct Point {
  int x, y;
  Point(int a, int b) : x(a), y(b) {}
  int sum() const { return x + y; }
};

class Blinker {

  explicit Blinker(int pin);
  void toggle();
 private:
  int pin_;
};

Blinker::Blinker(int pin) : pin_(pin) {}
void Blinker::toggle() {}
